intro: Fillion's Mission follows the aftermath of a reconnaissance effort to map elemental currents at the Overlook Standing Stones. The gathered data was intended to chart safe navigation lanes for skycutter ships traveling between Skywall and Azeroth, but the surveyor's incapacitation imperils the entire endeavor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.
The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for saving Fillion, friend. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is.

Without that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth are in serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret.
As ever, their own dogmatic hubris takes precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.
